All sounds in this folder are CC0 (public domain). Files were converted to mono
(48 kHz WAV for effects, 64 kbps Opus for music) and level-matched; nothing else was changed.

Kenney (www.kenney.nl), CC0 -- https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
  "Interface Sounds" pack:
    ui_hover.wav      <- select_001.ogg
    ui_confirm.wav    <- confirmation_001.ogg
    ui_click.wav      <- click_001.ogg
    place.wav         <- drop_002.ogg
    place_fail.wav    <- error_006.ogg
    select_units.wav  <- select_004.ogg
    order.wav         <- pluck_001.ogg
    pause.wav         <- minimize_005.ogg
    resume.wav        <- maximize_005.ogg
  "Impact Sounds" pack:
    hit_0..4.wav        <- impactSoft_medium_000..004.ogg
    basket_hit_0..2.wav <- impactWood_light_000..002.ogg
    basket_break.wav    <- impactWood_heavy_000.ogg

OpenGameArt.org, CC0:
  bgm_title.opus      <- "Flowerbed Fields [Loop]" by Zane Little Music
                         https://opengameart.org/content/flowerbed-fields-loop
  bgm_battle.opus     <- "Tower Defense Theme" by DST
                         https://opengameart.org/content/tower-defense-theme
  jingle_victory.opus <- win_1.ogg, "The War Over A Melon Field - Themes and Jingles" by Spring
  jingle_defeat.opus  <- lose_3.ogg, same pack (bicycle horn sound by AntumDeluge)
                         https://opengameart.org/content/the-war-over-a-melon-field-themes-and-jingles
